record.question: Every police officer while making an arrest shall prepare a memorandum of arrest under Section 36 of BNSS, 2023 which shall be
options: attested by at least two witnesses, one of whom should be a member of the family of the person arrested or a respectable member of the locality where the arrest is made
attested by at least one witness, who is a member of the family of the person arrested or a respectable member of the locality where the arrest is made
attested by at least two witnesses, one of whom should be a gazetted officer
attested by at least one witness
